texts.IR_JANES_SDF_answer: Jane's orbital intelligence contact supplies a watch list of suspected SDF personnel. Its Executive Action branch is the focus of the inquiry.
texts.IR_PIRATE_SDF_answer_1: Abonlo acknowledges occasional SDF protection work but offers no leadership identification.
texts.IR_PIRATE_SDF_answer_2: Abonlo recognises Jacob de Vries but has no ship-registration details.
texts.IR_PW_SDF_answer_1: PleasureWorld station records identify Jacob de Vries and Mosquito Sport registration354-JK564-B12. Send a registration trace to GalCop.
texts.IR_PW_SDF_answer_2: PleasureWorld supplies a saved security image of de Vries from its orbital departure terminal. GalCop will compare the evidence.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_1: Registration trace sent through the orbital station channel. Await GalCop's reply after calendar day{deadline}.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_2: GalCop identifies de Vries' orbital address at Luftslotte6 in Inorle. Follow the station lead.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_3: Inorle station services identify Luftslotte6 as a separate private orbital station. Use its actual docking clearance and reception contact.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_4: Luftslotte reception cannot reach de Vries through the station intercom. No further visit is authorised; return to your ship and follow the space lead.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_5: The recovered evidence consignment is radioactive and must remain sealed. Ordinary personal goods are preserved. Take the assigned sample and empty pod to OKB Korshkov at Aarzari.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_6: Korshkov orbital containment services receive the recorded sample and pod, decontaminate their carrier consignment and begin analysis. Other goods remain aboard. Results are due on calendar day{deadline}.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_7a: Korshkov identifies signatures consistent with a Zenith ZN-3A military drive and Sirius S-6 fuel. The original empty pod and its array are ready for release when your hold has1tonne free.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_7b: The original damaged pod is empty. Its surviving data array can be examined by the Naval Weapons Establishment at Arance.
texts.IR_NWE_SDF_answer_1a: Confirm handoff of the recovered array to Commander Nash's orbital laboratory. The service has no fee and consumes no unrelated goods.
texts.IR_NWE_SDF_answer_1b: NWE copies the recovered operational log into your mission records. It links orders signed Kinnaird to the de Vries contact at Luftslotte. The original array remains in laboratory custody.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_8a: An anonymous orbital message identifies Pieter Kinnaird as director of the SDF Executive Action branch and supplies a reference image.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_8b: The reference image matches the saved PleasureWorld station record: Jacob de Vries is an alias of Pieter Kinnaird.
texts.IR_SDF_quest_8c: The SDF evidence report is recorded with Ibanez. Return to Vegedius after resolving the other investigation strands. No additional payment or equipment is awarded here.
texts.IR_SDF_brief_0: Investigate the SDF's space operations and leadership.
texts.IR_SDF_brief_1: Follow the de Vries orbital station lead in Inorle.
texts.IR_SDF_brief_2: Take the protected radioactive sample and empty evidence pod to Korshkov's orbital containment service at Aarzari.
texts.IR_SDF_brief_3: Collect the analysed original evidence body at Aarzari after calendar day{deadline};1tonne clear hold is required.
texts.IR_SDF_brief_4: Follow up the recovered array through orbital laboratory and station-record contacts.
texts.IR_krait_seen: The assigned Krait is identified. Observe and follow its actual departure wormhole.
texts.IR_krait_seen2: The same Krait has arrived. Follow it and observe the emitted cargo.
texts.IR_krait_examine_cargo: Examine the actual emitted cargo. Reserve room for a sample and the later empty evidence pod.
texts.IR_fuel_sample_warning: Radioactive evidence detected in the protected cargo reservation.
texts.IR_radiation_damage: Aarzari Control: requesting hazardous-cargo containment assistance for the assigned evidence consignment.
texts.IR_korshkov_reply: Containment services are ready. Proceed to the actual main orbital station and confirm handoff.
texts.IR-garbled: Damaged capsule telemetry is garbled. This investigation's recovered pod is an empty evidence body, not a passenger rescue.
texts.IR-following-get-him: The assigned Krait is reacting to your pursuit.
texts.IR-prepare-hyperspace: The assigned Krait is preparing a jump; this message does not prove departure.
texts.IR-engaging: The Krait is attempting departure. Follow the real wormhole when admission is confirmed.
texts.IR-standby-jettison: The Krait is preparing to eject cargo. Track actual emitted bodies.
